provenance_basis: Frozen later in the same Monday, August 31, 2026 session after the user stated 21:45 Europe/Istanbul; host clock is known unreliable.
hypothesis: A smooth gene-wise source-consensus ramp isolates the cross-context-stable portion of the gamma relaxation, preserving exact PDS while improving NMAE, reach, and fidelity more consistently than a uniform or target-wise lambda.

gene_wise_selector.numeric_rule: Cast incumbent and direction arrays to float64 before subtraction.
gene_wise_selector.magnitude: minimum of the two absolute relaxation values
gene_wise_selector.eligible: both relaxation values finite and magnitude strictly positive
gene_wise_selector.midrank_percentile: (number of eligible magnitudes strictly smaller + (number equal + 1) / 2) / eligible_count
gene_wise_selector.agreement: HEK relaxation times HCT relaxation strictly greater than zero

desired_arithmetic_cpm.incumbent_cpm: Arithmetic mean of per-cell CPM from the frozen Experiment 150 incumbent emitted block.
desired_arithmetic_cpm.direction_cpm: Arithmetic mean of per-cell CPM from the frozen Experiment 150 gamma-0.45 emitted block.
desired_arithmetic_cpm.post_interpolation: Require finite nonnegative coordinates, then renormalize the vector to sum exactly 1000000 in float64 before bounded projection.
desired_arithmetic_cpm.allocator: Existing dual-moment two-depth bounded exact-margin projection and quasi allocation.
desired_arithmetic_cpm.required_invariant: Candidate integer column totals exactly equal incumbent integer column totals for every target.

primary_analysis.targets: 120 HEK-HCT common targets in frozen HCT order
primary_analysis.comparison_b: gene-wise candidate minus the higher projected-average frozen comparator among Experiment 150 uniform lambda 1 and Experiment 151 target-wise selector

decision_rule.otherwise: close this exact gene-wise consensus-ramp family; do not tune alternate percentiles, cutoffs, or coefficients on HCT outcomes

forbidden_before_source_build_authorizat: change the selector, interpolation, emission parameters, gates, or bootstrap seeds
